newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dlr shortfall.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7540/7560 to the dollar in interbank trading on Tuesday against a previous close at 43.7480/7500, dealers said.
The taka was traded slightly higher at 43.7480/7490 per dollar in early trading on the back of dollar selling by foreign banks and a large state-owned bank, dealers said.
It weakened after midday when the state-owned bank stopped selling the greenback, dealers added.
"The (state-owned) bank was due to receive a large amount of wage earners' remmittance today (Tuesday). But eventually the supply did not come," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed unchanged at five to 5.5 percent.
